categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in energy-saving, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. Its main business includes energy-saving services such as fuel-saving and comprehensive energy-saving retrofits, environmental protection services including low nitrogen combustion and industrial waste gas treatment, and new energy businesses covering mixed ammonia combustion, clean heating, photovoltaic, and biomass energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include plasma ignition and stable combustion for coal-fired boilers, digital image flame detection, intelligent combustion control, biomass co-firing technology, and molten salt thermal energy storage. The company employs EPC and EP project delivery models, custom-designing products based on client boiler conditions, and integrates digital and intelligent control technologies to enhance coal power flexibility and low-carbon transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large coal-fired power plants and energy companies, especially those under the State-owned National Energy Group. The company serves the coal power industry focusing on energy-saving and low-carbon retrofits, with expanding involvement in renewable energy sectors such as wind, photovoltaic, and geothermal energy. Major customers include state-owned enterprises and coal chemical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant business in North China, East China, Northwest China, Northeast China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China regions. It also has emerging overseas projects in countries like South Africa and Indonesia, aligning with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, providing technical services, equipment manufacturing, and engineering solutions for coal-fired power plants and new energy projects. It is positioned as a technology and service provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing coal power flexibility upgrades, low-carbon transformation through biomass and ammonia co-firing, intelligent combustion, and new energy storage technologies like molten salt storage. The company emphasizes R&D in digital twin technologies, AI-driven combustion optimization, and integration of multi-energy systems to support China's new energy system construction and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through EPC and EP project contracts, product sales of customized energy-saving and environmental protection equipment, and service fees for technical consulting and after-sales support. The company also earns investment income from equity participations in renewable energy projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and internationally recognized provider in coal power energy-saving and environmental protection retrofit services. It holds a strong market position supported by advanced proprietary technologies and strategic partnerships with major state-owned energy groups. Competitors include other specialized energy technology and engineering firms in the coal and renewable energy sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 1.28 billion RMB, a 13.06% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 65.3 million RMB, reflecting a 53.77% decline due to early-stage investments in new technologies. The company maintains a stable asset base of around 2.75 billion RMB and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with a 5.13% revenue ratio allocated to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through cutting-edge technologies in coal-fired boiler combustion optimization, flexible peak regulation, and low-carbon fuel integration. Its unique value lies in comprehensive lifecycle services for coal power plants, pioneering molten salt thermal storage solutions, and advanced digital and intelligent control systems, enabling clients to achieve cleaner, more efficient, and flexible power generation aligned with national carbon reduction strategies.
